items.title: Groupage (LTL)
items.description: We group your goods with other shipments, for small and medium volumes.
long: Your goods share the truck with other customers. You pay for the floor space you take up, not for the whole vehicle, so moving three pallets does not cost the same as moving thirty.

We run it on the daily Castellón ⇄ Madrid route: whatever we pick up during the day is consolidated that afternoon at our Almazora warehouse and leaves the same night. That is why a small shipment arrives just as fast as a large one.
includes: Pickup in more than 150 towns across the province of Castellón.
Consolidation at our own warehouse, with no third-party transfers.
Delivery in Madrid and neighbouring provinces within 24 hours.
Delivery notice and shipment tracking.
bestFor: You move between one and a dozen pallets.
Your volume is irregular and you do not always fill a truck.
You would rather ship small orders often than wait to fill a load.
items.heading: Pallet groupage between Castellón and Madrid
items.seoDescription: Groupage from one to twelve pallets. Collection across the province of Castellón, consolidation in our own warehouse and next-day delivery in Madrid.

items.title: Full truck (FTL)
items.description: A whole vehicle for your load, from origin to destination.
long: The vehicle runs for you alone, from origin to destination, with no intermediate stops and no handling along the way. What is loaded in Castellón is exactly what is unloaded at the far end.
It is the option when the deadline rules or the load is delicate: every extra handling is a breakage risk, and on a full truck there are only two, loading and unloading.
includes: 13.6 m curtain-sider trailer, up to 33 euro pallets.
Side loading: it can be loaded by forklift from the side, with no dock.
Loading and delivery times agreed with you.
Our own fleet: we do not subcontract the trip.
bestFor: You fill half a load or more.
The goods are fragile and you want no handling in between.
You need a specific delivery time.
items.heading: Full truckload from Castellón to Madrid
items.seoDescription: A 13.6-metre curtainsider carrying up to 33 euro pallets, for your freight alone. No transhipment, with loading and delivery times agreed with you.

items.title: National and international
items.description: Pickup, groupage and storage for clients in Spain and the EU.
long: Beyond the daily corridor we move goods to the rest of Spain and to European customers. The origin is usually the same — the province of Castellón — and what changes is the destination and the lead time.
For national destinations outside Madrid we work with scheduled departures; for Europe, with groupage or full truck depending on volume. In both cases we prepare the paperwork ourselves.
includes: Departures to national destinations from our Almazora warehouse.
Groupage and full truck for the European Union.
Transport paperwork prepared by us (CMR, delivery notes).
A single point of contact for the whole journey.
bestFor: You sell outside Madrid and do not want to build a carrier network.
You export to Europe and need departures from Castellón.
You want someone answerable for the shipment end to end.

items.title: Warehousing
items.description: Buffer warehouses and stock storage, in closed or open facilities.
long: More than 4,000 m² of our own warehousing between Almazora and Fuenlabrada. It is not space rented from a third party: it is ours, and that is what lets goods come in and go out when they need to without asking anyone.
It gets used two ways: as a buffer warehouse, to take the pressure off the factory in high season, and as permanent stock at the gates of Madrid, to serve orders the same day.
includes: Enclosed facilities and an open yard for material that allows it.
Goods in and goods out handled by us.
Stock control and counting.
Loading and unloading with our own forklifts.
bestFor: Your factory runs out of room in the busy months.
You want stock near Madrid without opening a branch.
You produce in batches but ship a little at a time.
items.heading: Warehousing and buffer stock in Castellón and Madrid
items.seoTitle: Warehousing and buffer warehouse in Castellón
items.seoDescription: Over 4,000 m² between Almazora and Fuenlabrada to hold your stock near the customer and release it as they ask for it, without filling up your factory.

items.title: Picking
long: We hold your goods and put orders together one by one: items are picked, built onto a pallet, shrink-wrapped and labelled ready to leave.
This is what turns a warehouse into a service. You send us the order and we leave it ready for that same night’s truck.
includes: Order preparation by item and quantity.
Pallet building, shrink-wrapping and labelling.
Delivery note and paperwork for each order.
Departure on the same day’s route if the order comes in on time.
bestFor: You ship many small orders out of a large stock.
You do not want to run a warehouse team of your own.
You sell to distributors with variable orders.
items.heading: Picking and order preparation
items.seoTitle: Picking and order preparation in Castellón
items.seoDescription: We put your orders together pallet by pallet or box by box: picking, shrink-wrapping, labelling and departure on the same day’s route.

items.title: Containers
long: We load and unload containers at our own facilities. What arrives is deconsolidated, palletised and enters the normal circuit; what leaves is loaded and made ready for the port.
Castellón is a port and it is tiles, so half the province moves containers. Having loading and unloading in the same warehouse where the goods are then stored saves you a whole trip.
includes: Container loading and unloading by forklift.
Palletising and shrink-wrapping of loose arrivals.
Immediate storage after unloading.
Load preparation for departure to the port.
bestFor: You import or export in containers from Castellón.
You need to deconsolidate without filling your own warehouse.
You want unloading and storage to happen in the same place.

about.title: Forty years on the same route
about.intro: Two warehouses of our own, in Almazora and Fuenlabrada, and a lorry that leaves every working day between Castellón and Madrid.
body: Transportes José María Ibáñez is a road transport company from Castellón specialised in palletised tiles and construction materials. We collect from 150+ towns across the province and deliver to Madrid within 24 hours.
We work from two sites: Almazora (Castellón) and Fuenlabrada (Madrid), with over 4,000 m² of our own warehousing. That lets us collect, consolidate and distribute without relying on third parties.
Beyond the daily Castellón ⇄ Madrid corridor, we serve the rest of Spain and European clients, with groupage, full truckload, warehousing, picking and container loading and unloading.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: What cookies this site uses, what they are for, and how to change your mind at any time.
cookies.whatText: It is a small file a website stores on your device when you visit. It is used to remember things, such as the language you picked. Some are set by us and some by an outside company, such as Google when we show you a map.

rows.name: tjmi_consent
rows.purpose: Stores which cookies you accepted and when, so we do not ask you again on every visit.

rows.name: NEXT_LOCALE
rows.purpose: Remembers whether you are viewing the site in Spanish or English.

rows.name: NID, SOCS and other Google cookies
rows.purpose: Set when the map of our depots loads. Google uses them to remember map preferences and for security.

sections.heading: What happens if you reject them
paragraphs: Nothing: the site works just the same. The only difference is that you will not see the embedded maps. Instead we show the written address and a link to open the location in Google Maps, if you want to.
We never load third-party cookies before you give us permission.

sections.heading: How to change your mind
paragraphs: Every page has a "Cookie preferences" link in the footer. From there you can give or withdraw your permission whenever you like, as easily as you gave it.
We will ask again after 12 months, or sooner if we add a new service.

sections.heading: Transfers outside the European Union
paragraphs: If you accept map cookies, Google may process your data outside the European Economic Area. Google relies on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. You can read their privacy policy at policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: How to delete them from your browser
paragraphs: Besides our panel, your browser lets you see and delete the cookies stored by any website:

paragraphs: Only what you give us. If you fill in the quote form: your name, your company, your email, your phone and whatever you write in the message.

paragraphs: To reply to you and prepare a quote. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6.1.b GDPR).

faq.intro: What we get asked most before a first shipment. If yours is not here, write to us and we will sort it out.
faq.ctaText: Tell us what you need to move and we will come back with a firm price.

a: The daily Castellón ⇄ Madrid route: transport of tiles and building materials, and also industrial equipment and spare parts.
We collect from more than 150 tile factories across the province of Castellón and deliver within 24 hours in Madrid and the surrounding area.

Yes. We handle bulky freight, with collection at the Castellón factories and delivery either to our Fuenlabrada (Madrid) site or straight to the final destination, in the Community of Madrid or nearby provinces.

items.q: Is there a minimum number of pallets?
a: No. We collect and consolidate all the goods in Castellón for transport and delivery in Madrid and neighbouring provinces; or for storage, if the destination is anywhere else in Spain.

items.q: Do you collect and consolidate goods for shipment to European countries?
a: Yes. We offer collection, groupage and storage of all the goods at our Castellón and Madrid sites for international customers.
We have long experience in logistics and transport with European companies.

items.q: Can you collect orders from several tile factories and consolidate them for Madrid?
a: Yes, that is exactly what we do every day. We collect from the different factories, consolidate everything in Castellón and it leaves on that night’s route for Madrid and the neighbouring provinces.
No. We carry palletised material and equipment at ambient temperature.
